messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — noticed p95 drift on route `chat-completions` since kernel v2.3.1. Baseline p95 ~210ms -> now 320ms for some tails. stack traces point to microbatching + KV churn.
ralph: Ugh. seen similar on canaries. Any pattern by tier/route?
sasha: Looks concentrated on customer-tier=standard and routes with long prefixes (codegen). KV hitrate dropped from 78% -> 61% last 4 hours.
jin: Did kernel change alter prefetch/kvcache eviction? We pushed kernel prefetch patch in v2.3.1.
maya: yeah, kernel switched to batched-gemv scheduling; runtime may be selecting larger microbatch sizes which flush KV earlier. proposing dynamic token budgets per tier: high-tier keep 256 token budget, standard drop to 128, burst tier 64 for p95 target 180ms.
olga: Can we try queue policy that favors 'short-first' (small token requests get higher weight) + cap per-route token budget? That should reduce amplification.
sasha: ran offline sim overnight: routing with token caps + short-first drops simulated p95 from 320ms -> 165ms, KV hit improves to 85% due to fewer premature evictions. attach: https://perf.internal/runs/529876
maya: Nice. What's cost delta?
observability-bot: baseline qps 420, token/sec down ~11%, estimated GPU utilization -3%.
ralph: sounds good. Plan: canary config to 10% of runtime fleet with flags:
```
batcher.policy=short_first
route_budget.override={'chat-completions':{'standard':128,'enterprise':256,'burst':64}}
kv.prefetch=true
```
maya: I'll draft the rollout playbook. Need perf regression guardrails: abort if p95 increases >5% or kv_hit <70%.
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout to 10% at 11:20 PDT
maya: After 20m, metrics: canary p95=170ms (from 320), kv_hit=83%, cost estimate neutral. rolling to 30%.
jin: kernel team: looks like the scheduling heuristics needed a runtime hint. We can expose microbatch ceiling via `batcher.max_microbatch_tokens`.
olga: follow-up: add `route_tier_profiles` to config so we can A/B different budgets per customer segment.
maya: assigning action items: (1) canary→50% if stable (me) (2) perf dashboard alert for kv_hit and p95 (sasha) (3) expose max_microbatch_tokens flag (jin)
ralph: thanks team :thumbsup:
